## Import and install libraries

```{r}

rm(list = ls())
library(reshape2)
library(devtools)
library(tictoc)
library(ggplot2)
library(mapdata)
library(geotools)
```

## Import data

```{r}

load("~/Desktop/geotools/demo/ERA5SL_daily_rh.Rdata")
load("~/Desktop/geotools/demo/ERA5SL_daily_lai_hv_matr.Rdata")
load("~/Desktop/geotools/demo/ERA5Land_daily_ssr_matr.Rdata")
```

## Perform geo-matching

```{r}

aggr_df <- geotools::geomatching(
  data = list(
    ERA5SL_daily_rh,
    ERA5SL_daily_lai_hv_matr
  ),
  settings = list(
    "format" = list(
      "xyt",
      "matrix"
    ),
    "type" = list(
      "grid",
      "grid"
    ),
    "crs" = list(
      4326,
      4326
    )
  ),
  aggregate = TRUE,
  group_by = "prov"
)
```
